text: Room opened — goal: security: Paranoid guard: scan for leaks/injection; VERIFY elements are REAL (not fake/dead); DETECT

name: Warden
text:
Decision: We will run a full asset inventory scan of all public-facing systems every 24 hours, not just the ones we think we own. The scan will check for live services, open ports, and unexpected software—even if it’s not in our CMDB. This catches shadow IT, forgotten boxes, and misconfigured services that attackers love to exploit.

Trade-off: The scan will cause a small load spike on some systems and may trigger false alarms in monitoring tools. We accept the noise and overhead because the alternative—missing a rogue server or exposed service—could mean a breach that costs far more to clean up.
